name: Mood Journal
description: One tap a day to log how you feel, with tags like sleep, work or friends, a colour calendar, streaks and what lifts your mood most.
prompt: A mood journal: pick how you feel from five faces, add tags like sleep, work, exercise or friends and an optional note, and see a month calendar coloured by mood, your streak and which tags lift your mood most.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Un toque al día para apuntar cómo te sientes, con etiquetas como sueño, trabajo o amigos, un calendario de colores, rachas y lo que más te anima.
